    Partner with us
We team up with organizations of every size to turn shared goals into real environmental action. Tell us who you are and we’ll take it from there.

Since the first Earth Day in 1970, the movement has grown into more than 1 billion people taking part every year in over 190 countries. Partnership means putting your organization’s work in front of that global audience.

Reach new audiences
                                        Connect with a global community of people ready to take action for the planet.

Promote your events
                                        Add your events to our award-winning Earth Day Map so people near you can find and join them.

Media visibility
                                        Your organization could be highlighted in our April media spotlights.

Earth Day resources
                                        Download partner branding and ready-made toolkits to plan and promote your work.

Progress takes people working across communities and generations. You don’t need to focus only on the environment — we welcome nonprofits that connect environmental action to the communities they serve, including:
Our work spans a broad network of environmental organizations, advocacy groups, and community partners. The organizations featured here represent just a selection of those collaborations.
